[[File:TheVenerableOne.jpg|thumb|right|The Venerable One held the Pearl of Wisdom in his hand.]]
The '''Pearl of Wisdom''' was a object of veneration for the [[Er'stacian]]s of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Er'stacia]]. They believed that their ancient forebear, represented by a giant statue known as the [[Venerable One]] or the Megalith, held the Pearl of Wisdom in his single, clawed [[Limb/Legends|hand]]. When [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] suggested splitting the statue in two to put a stop to a [[Er'stacian clan war|clan war]], both [[Red-armored Er'stacian clan|rival]] [[Green-armored Er'stacian clan|clans]] agreed that such a solution would never work because both would want to possess the Pearl of Wisdom.<ref name="Puzzle Peace">{{Tales|13|Puzzle Peace}}.</ref>
